title: Etale origin of coefficient-sized finitely presented local systems
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a commutative ring in an independent coefficient universe. Let F be a fixed-scalar module sheaf on the equivalent coefficient-sized pro-etale site. Suppose that, over every object, a covering sieve locally identifies F with constant finitely presented A-modules. Then F is in the essential image of the canonical fixed-scalar etale/pro-etale comparison inverse image. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed. The sites and comparison are those of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]; finite presentation is [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].

proof.text: Apply coefficientFpLocalSystem_etaleCover to obtain etale objects V_i whose pro-etale images cover the final object, with constant finitely presented slice models of F.

For each chart apply coefficientComparison_counit_isIso_of_constant_over to its actual slice isomorphism. Finite presentation is unnecessary for this counit calculation. Mathlib Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop then makes the global canonical comparison counit at F invertible.

Take the canonical sectionwise comparison direct image of F as the etale antecedent. The isomorphism asIso of its comparison counit is exactly an isomorphism from the prescribed comparison inverse image to F; this witnesses essential-image membership.

theorem coefficientFpLocalSystem_essImage (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    (hF : ∀ V : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X,
      ∃ S : Sieve V, S ∈ Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X V ∧
        ∀ (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) (f : U ⟶ V), S f →
          ∃ M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A, Module.FinitePresentation A M ∧
            Nonempty (F.over U ≅
              (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over U)
                (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj M)) :
    (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)).essImage F
